caption: Same 314 natural proteins (97 validation + 217 test), fixed 248B-token MarinFold. Standard structure predictors rank emitted ConFind degree>0 pairs by pLDDT_i × pLDDT_j × degree; residue pLDDT is mean heavy-atom confidence normalized to [0,1]. Filter resolved residues and separation ≥6 (all) or ≥24 (long) before selection. Denominator is R true contacts, floor(L/5), or floor(L/2) as indicated; unfilled ranks receive zero credit. Truth is degree≥0.001 and does not enter ranking. MarinFold consensus and Sequence KNN scores are unchanged. Neff80 on frozen alignments; equal protein means and 95% bootstrap intervals. Source: data/poster_product_figure_rows.csv and data/poster_product_summary.csv; pair ordering in the published ranked_pairs.parquet. See POSTER_NEFF.md.
